text: Mary Thompson's own claims put her in Turkey and India on the same day, 2025-09-23 — a single identity, no shared passport, one insurer. The date collision is real, but with dates-not-times data and no identity multiplexing this is far more likely a booking or discharge-date artifact than fraud, which is why it scores low. The economy genuinely produces a handful of these same-day artifacts among honest return patients. Next step: a look at the two claims' paperwork (CLM_0003477, CLM_0021410) to see which date is administrative; dismiss on confirmation.
